pr_title: ENH: support downcasting of nullable EAs in pd.to_numeric
pr_body:
- [x] closes #33013
- [x] tests added / passed
- [x] passes `black pandas`
- [x] passes `git diff upstream/master -u -- "*.py" | flake8 --diff`
- [ ] whatsnew entry

Picking up #33435.

In `pd.to_numeric` when encountering an `IntegerArray` and `FloatingArray` (or `Series` built from them) we downcast `_data` then reconstruct the array using the downcast `_data` and the `_mask` from the original array.

issue_context.title: ENH: Support downcasting of nullable dtypes in to_numeric

review_comments: this has to be here and not at module-level import because pandas.core.arrays.integer uses `to_numeric`

can you add a comment here and below on why you need to do this (use the masks). its obvious with the diff, but just the code its not so much why you are doing this.

now we *might* actually want to make this a context manager to do this (but likley overkill for this one particular case).

Done

> now we _might_ actually want to make this a context manager to do this (but likley overkill for this one particular case).

I'm down to do this (is follow-on ok or would you rather here?). I feel like it would be useful in a number of places (#37915 for example) and possibly some groupby algos
Let's leave that for a separate PR

Sounds good.

I may open an issue to discuss what we want the manager to look like before implementing
we *may* want to also accept `Float` and `Integer` as aliases for `float` | `integer` (separate issue)
I don't think we should do that, since those are not actually dtypes, but rather values to a `downcast` keyword which eg also accepts "signed"/"unsigned"
Can you add some cases with missing values?

Thanks!

Does it also work when starting with Float data *with* NA to downcast to integer?
Yes. Added those cases to the test in 23c4ae6
can you also try a *really* large int and uint  (e.g. np.iinfo(int64).max-1) and be sure that this is correctly handled

It works for large int

For unsigned int with large uint the constructor fails - I opened #38798 to track and xfailed the testcase here
